payload.name: Coffeetable
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Coffeetable helps you find your next book 

It brings one specific page from a book’s public preview. ChatGPT finds the page most relevant to what you are looking for and opens it in a focused reading experience.

Experience the author’s actual writing and decide whether the book is right for you.
payload.longDescription:
Coffeetable 帮你找到下一本书。

它会从书籍的公开预览中选取一个特定页面。ChatGPT 找到与你所寻找内容最相关的页面，并在专注的阅读界面中打开。

阅读作者真实的文字，判断这本书是否适合你。

payload.name: GenealogyDirect
payload.description: 获取或提供家谱研究帮助
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use GenealogyDirect to get help with family-history research or help others. Prepare actionable research questions, request copies of specific historical documents, discover requests that match your interests or location, submit offers, and review work you posted or joined. Nothing is published or submitted without your explicit confirmation.
payload.longDescription: 使用 GenealogyDirect 获取家族历史研究帮助，或为他人提供帮助。整理可执行的研究问题、申请特定历史文件的副本、发现符合你兴趣或所在地的请求、提交帮助提议，并查看你发布或加入的任务。未经你明确确认，不会发布或提交任何内容。

payload.name: HadithDB
payload.description: 搜索《古兰经》、经注和圣训
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and retrieve Quran ayahs, tafsir commentary, hadith search results, and detailed hadith records with Arabic and English text, source headings, grades, and canonical links.
payload.longDescription: 搜索并获取《古兰经》经文、经注解说、圣训搜索结果及详细圣训记录，包含阿拉伯语和英语文本、来源标题、可靠性等级及权威链接。

payload.name: EbooksDepository
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: EbooksDepository provides public bibliographic discovery for ebooks and audiobooks. Search by title, author, publisher, or language, inspect formats and catalog metadata, and retrieve a public record by slug. The connector is anonymous, read-only, and non-transactional.
payload.longDescription: EbooksDepository提供电子书和有声书的公共书目发现服务。可通过标题、作者、出版商或语言进行搜索，查看格式和目录元数据，并通过别名检索公共记录。该连接器为匿名只读模式，且为非事务性连接。

payload.name: Crazy Tongits – Learn & Review
payload.description: 逐步学习菲律宾塔吉特牌游戏
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Learn Filipino Tongits through short lessons, focused drills, and private practice against bots. See public bot actions, select cards on a mobile-friendly table, and review visible cards from private or completed hands. Explore a sourced Philippine variant guide with clearly marked rule differences and gaps; practice uses Crazy Tongits training rules, not every listed variant. Search curated source summaries for Crazy Tongits, Tongits Go, Tongits Star, and Tongits ZingPlay, keeping each brand and platform separate. Rule lessons support English, Filipino, and Taglish; brand source summaries are currently in English. Our goal is to make Tongits easier to understand for Filipino players through practical, evidence-based learning. No live account access, live human-match move advice, hidden-card guesses, wagering, or redeemable rewards. Independent research about other brands does not imply affiliation or official support.
payload.longDescription: 通过短课程、重点练习和与机器人对战的私密练习来学习菲律宾塔吉特牌游戏。查看公开机器人的操作，在移动端友好的牌桌选择牌面，并回顾私密牌局或已完成牌局的可见牌面。探索源自菲律宾的变种指南，清晰标注规则差异和空白；练习使用疯狂塔吉特训练规则，而非所有列出的变种。搜索精选的疯狂塔吉特、塔吉特Go、塔吉特Star和塔吉特ZingPlay资料摘要，保持每个品牌和平台的独立性。规则课程支持英语、菲律宾语和他加禄语；品牌来源摘要目前仅提供英语版本。我们的目标是通过实践性、基于证据的学习方式，让菲律宾玩家更容易理解塔吉特牌游戏。不提供实时账户访问、真人对战策略建议、暗牌猜测、下注或可兑换奖励。对其他品牌的独立研究不表示任何关联或官方支持。

payload.name: LiveCase
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LiveCase helps educators and learning designers create, inspect, and edit interactive case simulations through ChatGPT. Authors can work with case structure, characters, chapters, conversational content, questions, scoring characteristics, badges, debriefs, supporting files, and images. The plugin works only with cases the signed-in user is authorized to edit. Publishing, changing visibility, transferring ownership, and deleting an entire case remain in the LiveCase web application.
payload.longDescription: LiveCase 帮助教育工作者和学习设计师通过 ChatGPT 创建、检查和编辑互动式案例模拟。作者可以处理案例结构、角色、章节、对话内容、问题、评分特征、徽章、复盘材料、支持文件和图像。该插件只能用于已登录用户获授权编辑的案例。发布、改变可见性、转移所有权以及删除整个案例，仍需在 LiveCase 网页应用中完成。

payload.name: MolChart
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Draw and manipulate molecular structures and chemical reactions. Create molecules from SMILES, add atoms and bonds, and export to various formats.
payload.longDescription: 绘制和操作分子结构及化学反应。通过 SMILES 创建分子、添加原子和键，并导出为多种格式。

payload.name: Life in the UK Practice Tests
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Practise for the Life in the UK test — the citizenship test also known as the British citizenship test — without leaving the conversation. Ask to be quizzed and a full 24-question paper opens: official-style questions, single- and multi-answer, scored against the real 18 out of 24 pass mark, with a timer like the actual exam.

Ten complete tests are free and none of them need an account. At the end you get your score, whether you'd have passed, and a marked list showing exactly which questions you missed, so you know what to revise. Then you can start another test straight away.

Anyone sitting the test for British citizenship or for settlement (indefinite leave to remain) can use it. For the correct answer, an explanation and a memory tip on every question, a free account on lifeintheuk-tests.uk opens up the same result in full.
payload.longDescription:
无需离开对话，即可备考 Life in the UK 考试——这项公民考试也称为英国公民测试。要求开始测验后，系统会打开一份完整的 24 题试卷：题目风格贴近官方考试，包含单选和多选，按真实的 18/24 及格线评分，并设有与实际考试相似的计时器。

十套完整测试免费提供，且都无需账户。完成后，你会看到分数、是否通过，以及一份标记出具体错题的清单，便于了解需要复习的内容。之后可以立即开始下一套测试。

任何参加英国公民入籍或定居（无限期居留）考试的人都可以使用。若要查看每题正确答案、解释和记忆技巧，可在 lifeintheuk-tests.uk 注册免费账户，以完整形式打开相同结果。

payload.name: ClassWise School & District
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT or Codex to a curated, read-only ClassWise academic overview using an active school or district staff-member or administrator account. ClassWise can identify authorized organizations, list permitted district descendants, show academic terms and course-catalog entries, list classes with bounded basic day/time/room meetings, show class subjects, and return subject and bell-period schedule details only when the current role has schedule-management or gradebook permission. It returns one school-wide active-enrollment count per school, with counts below 10 suppressed. A school user remains limited to current active staff-member or administrator access for that school. A district user retains only the descendant-school scope already granted by an eligible ClassWise role. ClassWise rechecks current eligibility and permissions for every organization-specific request. The public connector cannot change ClassWise data and does not expose student-level records, per-class enrollment counts, enrollment cells by program, grade, or status, grades, attendance, health or medical information, disability or accommodation records, individual-service plans, discipline records, government-issued identifiers, finance or payment records, message content, credentials, authentication or role administration, raw SQL, arbitrary URLs, or platform controls. payload.name: Qulture
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Challenge your general knowledge with Qulture. Choose a category or play a random mix, answer each question through an immersive visual experience, then discover the correction and a memorable fact before viewing your final score.
payload.longDescription: 通过 Qulture 挑战你的常识。选择一个类别或随机混合类别，在沉浸式视觉体验中回答每个问题，然后查看答案解析和令人印象深刻的事实，最后查看总分。

payload.name: SuperQDA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SuperQDA connects your qualitative research workspace to ChatGPT. Access your research projects, documents, codes, and analyses directly in conversation.

What you can do:
- Browse and read all your uploaded documents (PDFs, Word files, transcripts)
- Perform semantic search across your research data using perform_semantic_search
- Create and apply qualitative codes to text segments using create_code and create_coded_segment
- Write analytical memos and save structured analyses
- Search for keywords across all project documents with perform_text_search

SuperQDA is a qualitative data analysis (QDA) platform used by researchers, academics, and students for thematic analysis, grounded theory, and other qualitative methodologies. This integration lets you leverage ChatGPT's reasoning capabilities directly on your research data without leaving the conversation.

All data access is secured with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE. Your credentials are never shared with ChatGPT.

SuperQDA 将你的定性研究工作区连接到 ChatGPT。你可以直接在对话中访问研究项目、文档、编码和分析。

payload.name: Clairwave
payload.description: 海洋声学与实时船舶信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Clairwave gives ChatGPT grounded ocean-acoustics answers instead of estimates from memory. Ask about any point in the world ocean and the plugin runs propagation physics on Clairwave's platform: parabolic-equation transmission loss along a bearing, sonar-equation detection ranges, and full 3D Bellhop transmission-loss volumes, driven by Clairwave-served bathymetry, seasonal sound-speed profiles and seabed acoustic parameters.

It also covers ships: search live AIS positions by name or MMSI, list vessels near a point, estimate a vessel's radiated-noise source level from its class, speed and dimensions, fetch a photo, open an MMSI-keyed 3D hull model from the open shipshape fleet, and compute the power-summed noise level at a fixed site such as a fish farm or hydrophone.

Every location accepts a place name ("outside Halifax", "Strait of Hormuz") as well as coordinates. Every simulation result carries a replication bundle (sound-speed profile, bottom parameters, bathymetry transect, grid) and a run id whose files are downloadable, plus a link that opens the run visualized in the Clairwave web platform with no sign-in.

Typical uses: sonar and hydrophone planning, marine-mammal noise exposure screening, aquaculture noise monitoring, teaching ocean acoustics, checking a ship's audibility at a receiver, and exploring how season and seabed change propagation. No account is required. Compute calls share a platform-wide budget of about 20 per minute. Results are climatology-based and are not a substitute for in-situ measurements.
payload.longDescription:
Clairwave 为 ChatGPT 提供有依据的海洋声学答案，而非凭记忆估算。询问全球海洋中的任意地点，插件就会在 Clairwave 平台上运行传播物理计算：沿指定方位的抛物方程传输损失、声呐方程探测距离，以及完整的 3D Bellhop 传输损失体积；计算使用 Clairwave 提供的海底地形、水体季节性声速剖面和海床声学参数。

它也支持船舶信息：按名称或 MMSI 搜索实时 AIS 位置、列出某地点附近的船只、根据船舶类别、速度和尺寸估算其辐射噪声源级、获取照片、打开来自开放 shipshape 船队且以 MMSI 为键的 3D 船体模型，并计算鱼场或水听器等固定地点的功率叠加噪声级。

地点既可使用地名（“哈利法克斯外海”“霍尔木兹海峡”），也可使用坐标。每项模拟结果都附带可复现数据包（声速剖面、海底参数、海底地形剖面、网格）和一个运行 ID，其文件可供下载；还提供一个链接，可在 Clairwave 网页平台中打开可视化结果，无需登录。

典型用途：规划声呐和水听器、筛查海洋哺乳动物噪声暴露、监测水产养殖噪声、教授海洋声学、检查接收点是否能听到某艘船，以及探索季节和海床如何改变传播情况。无需账户。计算调用共用全平台预算，每分钟约 20 次。结果依据气候学数据，不能替代现场测量。

payload.name: Padlet
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Padlet is a visual board platform used by teachers, students, and teams to collect, organize, and share content on collaborative boards called padlets. The Padlet app for ChatGPT connects the user's own Padlet account via OAuth so they can work with their padlets directly in conversation.

With this app, users can:
- Create padlets and organize them with sections, layouts, wallpapers, and appearance settings.
- Add, edit, arrange, pin, and sort posts, and draw connections between posts on Freeform boards.
- Read, search, and summarize board content, including AI analysis of images, videos, audio, and document attachments.
- Comment on posts and moderate discussion.
- Manage sharing settings by modifying permissions, passwords, collaborators, and email invitations.
- Schedule automations such as timed freezes, and freeze or unfreeze boards on demand.
- Grade student submissions and sync grades to a connected LMS (e.g. Canvas or Schoology) via LTI.
- For school and team library admins: manage membership and invitations, per-role permissions, SSO configuration (OAuth providers and SAML), approved email domains, content safety, and allowed attachment types.

The app does not yet fully support Padlet's Sandbox (whiteboard) format; it works with Padlet's other board formats.

All actions run against the authenticated user's Padlet account and respect Padlet's permission model — the app can only see and change what the signed-in user could see and change in Padlet itself. Deletions of posts and sections are soft-deletes that can be restored with a dedicated restore tool, and the small number of irreversible operations (deleting comments, automations, or custom fields, removing collaborators, invitations, or approved domains) are annotated as destructive so the assistant confirms with the user before proceeding.
payload.longDescription:
Padlet 是一个视觉化协作看板平台，教师、学生和团队可在名为 padlets 的协作看板上收集、整理和分享内容。ChatGPT 版 Padlet 应用通过 OAuth 连接用户自己的 Padlet 账户，让用户可直接在对话中使用自己的 padlet。

使用此应用，用户可以：
- 创建 padlet，并使用分区、布局、壁纸和外观设置进行整理。

- 阅读、搜索和总结看板内容，包括对图像、视频、音频和文档附件进行 AI 分析。
- 对帖子发表评论并管理讨论。
- 通过修改权限、密码、协作者和电子邮件邀请来管理共享设置。
- 安排定时冻结等自动化操作，并按需冻结或解冻看板。
- 为学生提交内容评分，并通过 LTI 将成绩同步到已连接的 LMS（例如 Canvas 或 Schoology）。
- 学校和团队资料库管理员可管理成员和邀请、按角色设置权限、配置 SSO（OAuth 提供方和 SAML）、批准的电子邮件域名、内容安全及允许的附件类型。

该应用目前尚未完全支持 Padlet 的 Sandbox（白板）格式，但支持 Padlet 的其他看板格式。

所有操作都针对已通过身份验证的用户 Padlet 账户，并遵循 Padlet 的权限模型——应用只能查看和更改登录用户在 Padlet 本身有权查看和更改的内容。删除帖子和分区属于软删除，可通过专用恢复工具还原；少数不可逆操作（删除评论、自动化或自定义字段，移除协作者、邀请或已批准域名）会标记为破坏性操作，因此助手在执行前会向用户确认。

payload.name: RubricMark Practice
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask for a practice test, school or university profile, admission score check, writing mark, or flashcards in ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini (same RubricMark MCP).

For a named exam (HAST, Selective, IELTS, JLPT, GAMSAT, and others), you get three sample questions and a sample mark, plus a link to create a RubricMark account for the timed sit.

Ask about a selective school, grammar school, or QS university — RubricMark returns curated School Guide profiles and first-party links (no invented cutoffs).

Ask whether a Selective, ATAR, SAT, ACT, GAMSAT, LSAT, or GMAT score is competitive — RubricMark opens the Admission Score Estimator with your numbers prefilled. Mapping stays on the site.

Link your RubricMark account to run a full criterion mark on a pasted draft, open a timed sit in the app, and get an improvement plan with next practice, retrieve cards, and learning materials.

Paste a writing draft for a short sample comment without linking. Linked accounts get the quoted report (credits / plan).

Plans and checkout stay on RubricMark. Nothing is sold in the host chat.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT、Claude 或 Gemini 中，获取练习测试、学校或大学档案、入学分数评估、写作评分或抽认卡（使用同一 RubricMark MCP）。

对于指定考试（HAST、Selective、IELTS、JLPT、GAMSAT 等），你将获得 三道样题和一份样例评分，以及创建 RubricMark 账户参加限时考试的链接。

payload.name: VoteMapper
payload.description: 绘制选举地图并统计席位
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask about a US election — the 2026 midterms ahead, or any presidential election since 1788 — and get an answer with a date on it.

For 2026: the consensus competitiveness rating for any of the 100 Senate seats and 435 House districts, a consensus of Cook Political Report and Sabato's Crystal Ball, along with which races are genuinely in play and what forecasters have changed their minds about since the last update.

The part a chat assistant cannot do on its own is the arithmetic. Describe a scenario in plain language — "Republicans hold every toss-up but lose Maine" — and VoteMapper resolves it against the ratings in effect and returns a full chamber map you can argue with. Click any race to reassign it and the tally follows. The Senate has 65 seats that are not on the 2026 ballot and are already counted; getting that right is the difference between a real answer and a confident wrong one.

For history: every presidential election from 1788 to 2024, as a map rather than a paragraph. Compare two elections and see which states changed hands, trace one state's whole voting history and current streak, or reassign states to ask what a different outcome would have meant. Multi-way elections like 1860 and 1912 come back whole rather than flattened into two parties.

You can also check a sealed VoteMapper forecast. A prediction declared in the app is verified here by fingerprint and scored against published race calls once results land — over called races only, so an uncalled race is never counted as a miss.

VoteMapper is a simulator. It reports no live vote counts, returns or called races, and its historical data holds electoral votes, not popular-vote totals. Every answer carries the date its data was published, both parties are treated symmetrically throughout, and the connector takes no position on any race.

Read-only and stateless: no account, no sign-in, nothing written, nothing retained between requests.
payload.longDescription:
询问美国选举——即将到来的 2026 年中期选举，或自 1788 年以来的任何一次总统选举——即可获得标注日期的答案。

关于 2026 年：可查看 100 个参议院席位和 435 个众议院选区的综合竞争力评级。该评级综合了 Cook Political Report 和 Sabato's Crystal Ball 的意见，同时指出哪些选战确实存在变数，以及预测者自上次更新以来改变了哪些判断。

聊天助手无法独立完成的部分是计算。用日常语言描述一种情景——例如“共和党保住所有势均力敌的席位，但输掉缅因州”——VoteMapper 会依据当前评级进行计算，并返回完整的议院席位地图供你讨论。点击任意选战即可重新分配席位，统计结果会随之更新。参议院有 65 个席位不在 2026 年改选范围内，并已计入结果；准确处理这一点，才能避免得到看似自信、实际错误的答案。

历史选举方面：可将 1788 年至 2024 年的每次总统选举以地图呈现，而非长篇文字。比较两次选举，查看哪些州易手；追踪某州完整的投票历史和当前连续纪录；或重新分配各州，探讨不同结果会带来什么影响。1860 年和 1912 年等多方竞争的选举会完整呈现，不会被简化成两党对决。

你还可以核验已封存的 VoteMapper 预测。用户在应用中提交的预测会在此通过指纹验证，并在结果公布后依据已发布的选战结果进行评分——只统计已经确认结果的选战，因此未出结果的选战不会被算作预测失误。

VoteMapper 是模拟工具。它不提供实时票数、计票回报或已确认胜者的选战结果；其历史数据记录选举人票，而非普选票总数。每个答案都会注明数据发布日期；对两党始终一视同仁；此连接器不支持任何选战。

只读且无状态：无需账户或登录，不会写入任何内容，也不会在请求之间保留数据。

payload.name: Flash
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Flash is a spaced-repetition flashcard app that ChatGPT can run for you. Tell ChatGPT what you're learning (paste a chapter, lecture notes, a vocabulary list, or just describe the topic) and it writes the cards into a deck in your Flash account, then shows them in a panel you can page through, with any edits beside what the card said before. When you want to study, say so: ChatGPT asks each due card, checks your answer (typed, or dictated with the mic) and grades it Again, Hard, Good, or Easy. A study panel also opens in the chat, so you can show each answer, tap the grade yourself, and see how far through the session you are. Grading is strict on numbers, doses, ranges, units, and names, which makes it a good fit for nursing, medicine, law, languages, and anything else where "close enough" isn't.

Every review is scheduled by FSRS, the modern spaced-repetition algorithm that models your memory and shows you each card right before you'd forget it. There are no settings to learn.

Nothing you drill with ChatGPT scrolls away: cards, answers, and review dates live in your Flash account, synced across devices, and you can also study on the web at flashmemorize.com. Existing Anki decks import whole (.apkg with cloze, hints, images, audio, LaTeX, typed answers, and nested decks), and everything exports back to Anki or CSV at any time.

What ChatGPT can do once connected: list your decks and due counts, create decks and cards, run a study session on one deck, a subdeck, or a set of tags, reveal answers, submit grades, edit or delete cards in batches, rename, nest, and archive decks, and adjust daily new-card limits.

A free Flash account is all you need. Flash has no ads, no tracking, and no third-party analytics.
payload.longDescription:
Flash是一款间隔重复记忆卡应用，ChatGPT可以为你运行该应用。告诉ChatGPT你正在学习的内容（粘贴一章内容、课堂笔记、词汇表，或直接描述主题），它会将卡片生成到你的Flash账户中的卡片组中，然后在面板中显示卡片供你翻阅，所有修改都会保留在卡片原有内容旁边。当你想学习时，只需说明即可：ChatGPT会逐张展示到期卡片，检查你的答案（输入或通过麦克风语音输入），并将其评为「再看一次」、「困难」、「良好」或「容易」。学习面板也会在聊天中打开，你可以展示每张答案，自行点击评分，并查看当前学习会话的进度。对于数字、剂量、范围、单位和名称等需要严格准确的内容，评分系统会特别严谨，这使其成为护理、医学、法律、语言学习以及其他任何「足够接近」都不够的领域的理想选择。

每次复习均由FSRS算法安排，这是现代的间隔重复算法，它会模拟你的记忆曲线，在你即将遗忘时展示每张卡片。这里没有任何需要学习的设置。

通过ChatGPT练习的任何内容都不会消失：卡片、答案和复习日期都会保存在你的Flash账户中，跨设备同步，你也可以在flashmemorize.com网站上学习。现有的Anki卡片组可完整导入（支持包含删除填空、提示、图片、音频、LaTeX、输入答案和嵌套卡片的.apkg文件），且任何时候都可以将所有内容导出回Anki或CSV格式。

连接ChatGPT后可实现的功能：列出你的卡片组及到期数量，创建卡片组和卡片，对单个卡片组、子卡片组或一组标签执行学习会话，显示答案，提交评分，批量编辑或删除卡片，重命名、嵌套和归档卡片组，调整每日新卡片上限。

只需一个免费的Flash账户即可使用。Flash无广告、无跟踪、无第三方分析。

payload.name: RooQuiz
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RooQuiz helps teams create knowledge quizzes, scored assessments, and outcome quizzes; configure questions, reports, translations, and sharing; and review masked respondent, lead, booking, and performance data through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: RooQuiz 帮助团队创建知识问答、计分测评和结果测验；配置问题、报告、翻译和分享；并通过 ChatGPT 查看经过脱敏的答题者、潜在客户、预订和表现数据。

payload.name: Dentovio Exam Prep
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and retrieve Dentovio’s published dental exam-preparation references with public source links, verification dates, and explicit review context. Dentovio Exam Sources is read-only and excludes account access, checkout, paid content, recalled exam items, patient data, and personalized clinical, legal, or licensure advice.
payload.longDescription: 通过公开来源链接、验证日期和明确的审查背景，搜索并检索Dentovio发布的牙科考试备考参考资料。Dentovio考试资料为只读模式，不包含账户访问权限、结账功能、付费内容、召回的考试题目、患者数据以及个性化的临床、法律或执照建议。

payload.name: Glow Research Docs
payload.description: 阅读并比较实验室文件
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find reviewed Glow public research documentation, read a cited example laboratory report, and compare a lot label with the report’s lot identifier. The app explains testing scope and preserves missing or unverified evidence. It uses a bounded public-source collection and does not provide live catalog coverage, medical-use advice, purchases, or private account information. Developed by TaskChad for Glow Peptides; published by Quotemoto.
payload.longDescription: 查找经审核的 Glow 公开研究文档，阅读带引用的实验室报告示例，并将批次标签与报告中的批次标识符进行比较。该应用会说明检测范围，并保留缺失或未经核实的证据。它使用范围有限的公开来源集合，不提供实时目录覆盖、医疗用途建议、购买服务或私人账户信息。由 TaskChad 为 Glow Peptides 开发，并由 Quotemoto 发布。

payload.name: AI Museum
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI Museum helps people explore five eras of artificial intelligence, inspect fifteen curated exhibits, and test their knowledge with short bilingual quizzes. It is a read-only educational companion and does not modify the separate full game.
payload.longDescription: AI Museum 帮助人们探索人工智能的 5 个时代、查看 15 个精选展项，并通过简短双语测验检验知识。它是只读的教育助手，不会修改独立的完整游戏。

payload.name: Funlearny
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create multiple-choice quizzes from a topic or your lesson notes. Review 1–20 questions with 2–4 choices and one correct answer per question, simplify them, or translate them. Open the preview in Funlearny, sign in, and choose Save to keep it as a private draft. Designed for teachers and adult learning-content creators. Quizzes are never published automatically.
payload.longDescription: 根据主题或课堂笔记创建选择题测验。查看 1–20 道题目，每题有 2–4 个选项和一个正确答案；还可以简化题目或翻译题目。在 Funlearny 中打开预览并登录，然后选择 Save，将其保存为私人草稿。适用于教师和成人学习内容创作者。测验不会自动发布。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TeacherGPT turns a captioned YouTube video into an interactive multiple-choice quiz, saves it behind an unlisted lesson link, and lets users retrieve or delete a lesson by its ID.
payload.longDescription: TeacherGPT 可将带字幕的 YouTube 视频转换成交互式选择题测验，将测验保存在一个未公开的课程链接后，并允许用户通过课程 ID 获取或删除课程。

payload.name: Rexa
payload.description: 基于 KOTC 数据的 MCAT 辅导
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Rexa securely connects to the user's own King of the Curve account through OAuth. It helps the connected MCAT learner understand their study snapshot, aggregate subject performance, exam progress, and published KOTC resources. Rexa identifies evidence-backed study priorities and explains recent trends without changing study records or accessing another learner's account.
payload.longDescription: Rexa 通过 OAuth 安全连接用户自己的 King of the Curve 账户。它帮助已连接账户的 MCAT 学习者了解学习概况、各科汇总表现、考试进度和已发布的 KOTC 资源。Rexa 会根据证据找出学习重点并解释近期趋势，不会更改学习记录，也不会访问其他学习者的账户。

payload.name: Read Frog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Read Frog learning workspace to find saved vocabulary and reading notes, organize notebases, manage flashcard templates, and understand your study progress.

Search notes by text, inspect notebase fields, save new learning material, and update existing notes. View generated flashcards, review history, and study statistics. When you request changes and grant the relevant permissions, Read Frog can also record reviews and update study settings.

Requires a Read Frog account with existing Ultra access. You choose which account, notebase, note, template, and study permissions to grant during authorization. The integration can read and write your data according to those permissions. Deleting notes, fields, templates, or notebases can remove related learning content.
payload.longDescription:
连接 Read Frog 学习工作区，查找已保存的词汇和阅读笔记、整理笔记库、管理闪卡模板，并了解学习进度。

按文本搜索笔记、查看笔记库字段、保存新的学习材料并更新现有笔记。查看生成的闪卡、复习历史和学习统计数据。当你请求更改并授予相应权限后，Read Frog 还可以记录复习并更新学习设置。

需要拥有现有 Ultra 权限的 Read Frog 账户。授权时，你可以选择授予哪些账户、笔记库、笔记、模板和学习权限。集成会根据这些权限读取和写入你的数据。删除笔记、字段、模板或笔记库可能会移除相关学习内容。

payload.name: Gordito
payload.description: 面向语言学习者的词汇本
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gordito is a personal language-learning companion that lives inside ChatGPT. Save words and phrases from any conversation directly to your notebook, then let the built-in spaced-repetition scheduler (FSRS) decide exactly when each word needs reviewing. When it is time to practice, Gordito builds a quiz from the words that are due, grades your answers honestly, and writes every correction in the language you are learning so that reading the feedback is itself practice. Your progress syncs across devices: start a quiz on your laptop and finish it on your phone. Gordito covers vocabulary building and spaced-repetition quizzing for language learners. It does not cover grammar courses, pronunciation coaching, live tutoring, translation services, travel booking, or general reference lookup.
payload.longDescription: Gordito 是一款内置于 ChatGPT 的个人语言学习助手。将任何对话中的单词和短语直接保存到笔记本，然后由内置的间隔重复计划器（FSRS）准确安排每个词的复习时间。练习时间到后，Gordito 会用待复习词汇生成测验，认真批改你的答案，并使用你正在学习的语言写出所有更正，让阅读反馈本身也成为练习。你的进度会在不同设备间同步：可以在笔记本电脑上开始测验，再用手机完成。Gordito 专注于词汇积累和间隔重复测验，不提供语法课程、发音指导、实时辅导、翻译服务、旅行预订或通用参考查询。

payload.name: CanQuiz
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CanQuiz saves the quizzes ChatGPT writes for you into your own account and helps you review them until the exam.

Ask ChatGPT for a quiz on your notes or on a topic. ChatGPT writes the questions, and CanQuiz checks them and saves them in your account, with a link. They no longer get lost in a conversation.

What you can ask:

"Save this quiz to CanQuiz": it is saved and you get the link.
"Show me my quizzes" or "open the History one": it lists them or shows you one.
"Change question 4": it changes that question and leaves the rest alone.
"Add it to my reviews": CanQuiz brings it back on the right days so you do not forget it.
"What do I need to review today?": it asks one question at a time without showing the answer. CanQuiz marks it and decides when each question comes back.
"Give me the link to open it": it takes you to your quiz in CanQuiz, without sharing it with anyone.
"Give me the link for my class": the quiz is shared with a link that opens in any browser, outside ChatGPT.
"Make it private again": whoever has the link can no longer open it.
"Delete this quiz": it is deleted once you confirm.
Your quizzes are yours: they are also at app.canquiz.com, where you can take them, review them, share them or download them. And you can remove ChatGPT's access whenever you like from Settings, under "Connected apps".

Requires a CanQuiz account, which is free.
payload.longDescription:
CanQuiz会将ChatGPT为您撰写的测验保存到您的账户，并帮助您复习直到考试。

向ChatGPT请求基于笔记或主题的测验。
ChatGPT会生成问题，CanQuiz将检查并保存到您的账户并提供链接。
它们不再会丢失在对话中。

您可以提出以下请求：

「将此测验保存到CanQuiz」：会将其保存并为您提供链接。
「显示我的测验」或「打开历史记录」：会列出所有测验或展示某个测验。
「修改第4题」：会修改该题内容，其余题目保持不变。
「加入我的复习计划」：CanQuiz会在合适日期提醒您复习，避免遗忘。
「我今天需要复习什么？」：会逐题提问且不显示答案。
CanQuiz会标记答题情况并决定每题的复习时间。
「给我打开测验的链接」：会跳转至CanQuiz中的测验页面，且不与他人共享。
「给我班级用的链接」：测验会通过浏览器独立链接分享，不依赖ChatGPT。
「将其设为私有」：持有链接的人将无法打开该测验。
「删除此测验」：确认后会立即删除。
您的测验数据属于您：也可在app.canquiz.com访问，可进行测验、复习、分享或下载。
您可在设置中的「已连接的应用」里随时移除ChatGPT的访问权限。

需要拥有免费的CanQuiz账户。

payload.name: Katav
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Katav helps students use their own Katav study subjects and class context in ChatGPT. Users can list their current study subjects, inspect a selected subject's recent classes, and use that private context to plan review or ask study questions.
payload.longDescription: Katav 帮助学生在 ChatGPT 中使用自己的 Katav 学习科目和课堂上下文。用户可以列出当前学习科目、查看所选科目最近的课程，并利用这些私密上下文规划复习或提问学习问题。

payload.name: Interview Trix
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Interview Trix helps you build a job-ready resume and practice for interviews without leaving ChatGPT.

Connect your Interview Trix account, then ask ChatGPT to list your resumes, create a new draft from your experience, update skills or titles in place, or retarget a saved resume for a specific role. You get an editor link on interviewtrix.com to review layout, templates, and the full document.

When you have a role in mind, ChatGPT can run ATS scoring against a job description and show the top issues to fix. When you are ready to practice, it can start a timed AI mock interview (15 or 30 minutes, depending on your plan) and return a link to take it on Interview Trix. Completed interviews can be opened later for scores and reports if your plan includes them.

Interview Trix does not apply to jobs, email recruiters, or delete your account. Live interviews run on interviewtrix.com, not inside the chat. Resume count, ATS, and mock-interview credits follow your Interview Trix plan.
payload.longDescription:
Interview Trix 帮助你在不离开 ChatGPT 的情况下制作适合求职的简历并练习面试。

关联 Interview Trix 账户后，可让 ChatGPT 列出你的简历、根据经历创建新草稿、直接更新技能或职位名称，或针对特定职位调整已保存的简历。你会获得 interviewtrix.com 的编辑器链接，以便查看版式、模板和完整文档。

确定目标职位后，ChatGPT 可以根据职位描述进行 ATS 评分，并指出最需要修正的问题。准备好练习时，可启动限时 AI 模拟面试（根据套餐时长为 15 或 30 分钟），并返回 Interview Trix 上的面试链接。如果你的套餐包含相关功能，完成的面试之后还可打开查看分数和报告。

Interview Trix 不会替你申请职位、给招聘人员发邮件或删除账户。实时面试在 interviewtrix.com 上进行，不在聊天中进行。简历数量、ATS 和模拟面试额度均按你的 Interview Trix 套餐执行。

payload.name: Sauna Monthly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sauna Monthly is an independent editorial site on saunas, heaters, cold plunges and recovery gear. This plugin lets ChatGPT search its catalogue of 83 products with real specifications, US prices and where to buy; read the site's reviews and editorial ratings; compare two to four products side by side; size a sauna heater from room dimensions; estimate what a sauna costs to run from heater power, session length and your electricity rate; and read any of its 32 articles, from brand reviews to the research behind heat and cold. Every answer links to the page it came from on saunamonthly.com. No account is needed and nothing about you or the conversation is stored.
payload.longDescription: Sauna Monthly 是一个独立的桑拿、加热器、冷水浴和恢复装备编辑网站。此插件让 ChatGPT 搜索其包含 83 款产品的目录，其中有真实规格、美国价格和购买渠道；阅读网站评测和编辑评分；并排比较二到四款产品；根据房间尺寸选择桑拿加热器规格；根据加热器功率、使用时长和电费估算桑拿运行成本；还可阅读其 32 篇文章，内容涵盖品牌评测以及冷热疗法背后的研究。每条回答都会链接到 saunamonthly.com 上的来源页面。无需账户，也不会存储关于你或对话的任何信息。

payload.name: BaniDB
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: BaniDB helps users search authentic Gurbani by topic or phrase, read complete Shabads and Banis, retrieve Angs and the daily Hukamnama, and look up Gurbani words. Results include source text, translations, and references returned by BaniDB.
payload.longDescription: BaniDB 帮助用户按主题或短语搜索真实的 Gurbani 经文，阅读完整的 Shabads 和 Banis，获取 Angs 及每日 Hukamnama，并查询 Gurbani 词语。结果包含 BaniDB 返回的源文本、译文和参考出处。

payload.name: UX Jobs
payload.description: 查找实时 UX 与设计职位
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
UX Jobs is a curated, no-ads job board for UX, product-design, UX-research and content-design roles — 4,000+ live listings from 2,200+ companies, aggregated from 60+ applicant-tracking systems, re-verified against each employer on every run so closed roles disappear instead of lingering, and refreshed several times a day.

With this plugin ChatGPT searches the board directly. Ask for remote senior product-designer roles that post a salary above a figure, UX-research openings in London, or which companies opened the most design roles in Germany this week. Pull any listing's details — location, workplace, posted salary, a description excerpt and the employer's apply link — with a link to the role on jobs.uxjobs.io. Two analytics tools give a live snapshot of the design hiring market (totals, new this week, remote share, seniority and discipline mix, top countries, cities and employers) and median posted salaries by seniority.

Read-only, free, no account or sign-in required. Seniority and discipline are derived from job titles; salary medians use only roles that post a USD range.
payload.longDescription:
UX Jobs 是一个精选、无广告的 UX、产品设计、UX 研究和内容设计职位板，拥有 4,000+ 个实时职位，来自 2,200+ 家公司，汇总自 60+ 个招聘跟踪系统；每次运行时都会向各雇主重新核实，已关闭的职位会被移除，不会长期滞留，并且每天刷新数次。

使用此插件，ChatGPT 可以直接搜索职位板。你可以查找薪资高于指定金额的远程高级产品设计职位、伦敦的 UX 研究岗位，或询问本周德国哪些公司新增了最多设计职位。可获取任意职位的详情——地点、工作方式、已公布薪资、职位描述摘录和雇主申请链接——并附上 jobs.uxjobs.io 上该职位的链接。两种分析工具提供设计招聘市场的实时概览（职位总数、本周新增、远程职位占比、资历和专业领域构成、热门国家/城市/雇主），以及按资历划分的已公布薪资中位数。

只读、免费，无需账户或登录。资历和专业领域根据职位名称推断；薪资中位数仅使用公布 USD 薪资范围的职位计算。

payload.name: TÕPS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TÕPS is an Estonian-language teacher toolkit from Tehisarud.ee for lesson plans, group work, playful practice activities and short lesson openings. Provide the grade, subject and topic, then choose the material you need. Four read-only MCP tools supply teaching workflow guides; ChatGPT uses those guides to compose materials in the conversation. Teachers review and adapt the results before classroom use.
payload.longDescription: TÕPS 是 Tehisarud.ee 提供的爱沙尼亚语教师工具包，适用于教案、小组活动、趣味练习和简短课堂开场。提供年级、科目和主题，然后选择所需材料。4 个只读 MCP 工具提供教学流程指南；ChatGPT 会在对话中依据这些指南编写材料。教师应在课堂使用前审阅并调整结果。

payload.name: Clasora Tutor Finder
payload.summaryOriginal: Find a tutor for a lesson.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search Clasora for a tutor by subject, language, city or price. Each result
shows what they charge, what past students said, and the times they are
genuinely free, so you can check a real opening before committing. Booking is
completed on clasora.com.
payload.longDescription:
在 Clasora 按学科、语言、城市或价格搜索导师。每条结果
都会显示收费、往届学生的评价，以及导师确实有空的时间，这样你就能在决定前确认有真实空档。预订
需在 clasora.com 上完成。

payload.name: Povtori
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn useful phrases into focused translation practice. Save the expressions you want to remember, choose your language pair, and work through guided lessons in ChatGPT. Povtori keeps your phrase list, resumes unfinished lessons, and shows your progress so you can focus on what still needs practice.
payload.longDescription: 将实用短语转化为有针对性的翻译练习。保存想记住的表达，选择语言组合，然后在 ChatGPT 中完成引导式课程。Povtori 会保存你的短语列表、恢复未完成的课程并显示学习进度，让你专注练习仍不熟悉的内容。

payload.name: Bench Coach
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bench Coach helps youth, travel, high-school, and college-adjacent baseball coaches turn real coaching questions into practical next steps. It provides focused workflows for age-tier fundamentals, practice planning, postgame analysis from coach-provided GameChanger exports or screenshots, lineups and defense, pitch sequencing, visual teach boards, parent communication, and player development.
payload.longDescription: Bench Coach 帮助青少年、旅行球队、高中及大学相关棒球教练，将真实的执教问题转为切实可行的下一步。它提供聚焦的工作流程，涵盖分年龄基础技能、训练规划、依据教练提供的 GameChanger 导出文件或截图开展赛后分析、阵容和防守、配球顺序、可视化教学板、家长沟通和球员发展。

payload.name: أرشيف الإسلام
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: IslamArchive provides direct access to documented Quranic resources, including Tafsir, Quranic word meanings, grammatical analysis (I‘rab), reasons for revelation, similar passages, recitation variants, verse and surah topics, roots and derivatives, and an audio library covering Tafsir, Quranic studies, Islamic thought, and spiritual development. Results include source names and links when available.
payload.longDescription: IslamArchive 可直接访问有文献依据的《古兰经》资源，包括经注、经文词义、语法分析（I‘rab）、启示缘由、相似段落、诵读异文、经文和章节主题、词根与派生词，以及涵盖经注、古兰经研究、伊斯兰思想和灵性成长的音频库。可用时，结果会附上来源名称和链接。

payload.name: קבלה ובינה - עוזר לכתבי הסולם
payload.description: 《巴尔·苏拉姆著作》学习与搜索助手
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: עוזר ללימוד וחיפוש בכתבי בעל הסולם, בנאמנות למקורות ובשפה בהירה.
payload.longDescription: 用于学习和搜索巴尔·苏拉姆著作的助手，忠实依据原文并以清晰易懂的语言呈现。

payload.name: LocalKidsGuide
payload.description: 查找附近适合孩子的活动
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LocalKidsGuide is a discovery platform purpose-built for families. Instead of scattered listings, it organizes kids' activities, events, and kid-friendly places into one structured, standardized directory, so parents get age-appropriate results for their children every time. Ask for things to do with your kids — swim lessons, art camps, story times, playgrounds, museums, indoor play spaces — and filter by your child's age, category, and price. It works around home and while traveling: check which cities are covered, search near any of them, and jump straight to an activity's full details and registration page on localkidsguide.com. All results come from LocalKidsGuide's moderated public directory.
payload.longDescription: LocalKidsGuide 是专为家庭打造的活动发现平台。它不再让信息散落各处，而是将儿童活动、事件和适合孩子的场所整理为结构统一的目录，让家长每次都能找到适合孩子年龄的内容。询问适合带孩子参加的活动，例如游泳课、艺术营、故事会、游乐场、博物馆和室内游乐空间，并按孩子年龄、类别和价格筛选。无论在家附近还是旅行途中都能使用：查看覆盖的城市、搜索这些城市附近的活动，并直接打开 localkidsguide.com 上的活动详情和报名页面。所有结果均来自 LocalKidsGuide 经过审核的公开目录。

payload.name: Black Tech Mafia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore Black Tech Mafia (BTM), a community organization that teaches technology through music, video, and short story lines.

With this plugin you can:
- Learn about BTM's mission and programs
- Get details on the free AI Youth Bootcamp for high school juniors and seniors, with a link to apply on blacktechmafia.com
- Browse BTM merchandise (T-shirts and a mousepad); orders are placed on an external form
- Watch the featured BTM video on YouTube
- Read the founder story
- Share a first name and email address to receive updates from BTM

The plugin collects only a first name, email address, and optional area of interest, and only when you ask to be contacted. It does not request health, biometric, financial, payment card, or government ID information. For bootcamp inquiries, the parent or guardian should submit the contact details.
payload.longDescription:
探索Black Tech Mafia（BTM），这个社区组织通过音乐、视频和短篇故事传授技术知识。

使用此插件，你可以：
- 了解BTM的使命和项目
- 获取面向高中三、四年级学生的免费AI Youth Bootcamp详情，以及blacktechmafia.com上的申请链接
- 浏览BTM周边商品（T恤和鼠标垫）；通过外部表单下单
- 在YouTube上观看BTM推荐视频
- 阅读创始人的故事
- 提供名字和电子邮件地址，接收BTM的最新消息

插件仅在你要求联系时收集名字、电子邮件地址，以及可选的兴趣领域。它不会索取健康、生物识别、财务、支付卡或政府身份证件信息。关于训练营的咨询，应由家长或监护人提交联系信息。

payload.name: MediPrep Study Navigator
payload.description: 将课程映射为学习路径
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MediPrep Study Navigator helps medical students turn lectures and study topics into reviewed, source-safe learning routes. ChatGPT analyzes learner-provided files and sends MediPrep only short medical concept phrases; MediPrep returns coordinated video metadata, rights-approved shared UWorld question IDs when available, public references, and human-published MediPrep practice. MediPrep does not receive uploaded files or proprietary question bodies. Third-party product names are used descriptively; MediPrep is not affiliated with or endorsed by their owners.
payload.longDescription: MediPrep Study Navigator 帮助医学生将课程和学习主题转化为经过审查、来源合规的学习路径。ChatGPT 分析学习者提供的文件，仅向 MediPrep 发送简短的医学概念短语；MediPrep 返回配套的视频元数据、在可用时提供经权利许可共享的 UWorld 题目 ID、公开参考资料，以及由人工发布的 MediPrep 练习。MediPrep 不会接收上传的文件或专有题目的正文。第三方产品名称仅用于描述；MediPrep 与这些名称的所有者不存在关联，也未获其背书。

payload.name: Joe Speaking
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Joe Speaking to ChatGPT to explore current IELTS Speaking questions, see which topics you have or have not practised, review your saved Recording Practice and Live Conversation history, discuss scores and feedback, and choose what to practise next.
payload.longDescription: 将Joe Speaking连接至ChatGPT，探索当前雅思口语题目，查看已练习或未练习的主题，回顾保存的录音练习和实时对话历史，讨论分数与反馈，并选择下一步练习内容。

payload.name: 受験王
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 受験王 helps users create custom multiple-choice study questions in ChatGPT and save them to a private question library for later review and practice.
payload.longDescription: 受験王 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中创建自定义选择题，并将其保存到私人题库，以便之后复习和练习。

payload.name: 교보문고
payload.description: 发现好书，找到心仪读物
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kyobo Book Centre is Korea's largest and most trusted bookstore. Search for the books you want and discover new reads—all without leaving the chat.
• Looking for a specific author? – "Which Han Kang book should I start with?"
• Browsing by topic? – "Show me popular books on investing"
• Need one for the moment? – "I just became a team lead—what should I read?"
• Picking a gift? – "A book for my history-loving dad"
No keyword guessing needed. Kyobo Book Centre finds your next read.
payload.longDescription:
Kyobo Book Centre 是韩国规模最大、最受信赖的书店。无需离开聊天，即可搜索想读的书并发现新书。
• 在找某位特定作者的书？——“我该从韩江的哪本书开始读？”

• 正在挑礼物？——“给我爱历史的爸爸挑一本书。”
无需猜关键词。Kyobo Book Centre 帮你找到下一本好书。

payload.name: 小テストジェネレーター
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PrintGenerator helps users search public vocabulary lists and their own UserBook lists from ChatGPT. It supports vocabulary details, flashcards, multiple-choice quizzes, and study using remembered or unremembered words. When needed, it can also create a share link to open a list in the Flutter app.
payload.longDescription: PrintGenerator 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 搜索公开词汇表和自己的 UserBook 词表。它支持词汇详情、抽认卡、选择题测验，以及使用已记住或尚未记住的单词进行学习。必要时，还可以创建分享链接，在 Flutter 应用中打开词表。

payload.name: 1 Billion Brain Cells
payload.description: 与 ChatGPT 一起训练大脑
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A fun and easy way to do brain training with ChatGPT!

e.g.

- "@1 Billion Brain Cells, let's work on my recall"
- "Help me train my vocabulary, @1 Billion Brain Cells"
- "@1 Billion Brain Cells, I want to improve my focus"
payload.longDescription:
与 ChatGPT 一起进行脑力训练的轻松有趣方式！

例如：

- “@1 Billion Brain Cells，我们来训练我的记忆回想能力”
- “帮我训练词汇能力，@1 Billion Brain Cells”
- “@1 Billion Brain Cells，我想提高专注力”

payload.name: SAMRUM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your SAMRUM account to talk through your family's personality profiles, reports and focus tracks in ChatGPT.

SAMRUM is a family personality tool: each person takes their own test at samrum.io and gets a profile of 10 everyday tendencies, based on the Big Five and the Interpersonal Circumplex. SAMRUM then shows the patterns that arise between two people – partners, parent and child, or siblings.

In ChatGPT you can:
- ask what your own profile says, or compare two family members side by side (shown as a chart)
- go through a couple, parent-child, sibling or family report one pattern at a time
- see this week's step in a focus track
- revisit your latest Right now guides after an argument

ChatGPT only reads what you can already see in SAMRUM. It shows nicknames and coarse levels (high, middle, low) – never raw answers, exact scores or full names – and it can't change anything in your account. You need a SAMRUM account with at least one completed test.
payload.longDescription:
连接你的 SAMRUM 账户，在 ChatGPT 中讨论家人的性格档案、报告和重点培养计划。

SAMRUM 是一款家庭性格工具：每个人都在 samrum.io 完成自己的测试，并获得一份基于大五人格和人际环形模型的档案，其中包含 10 项日常倾向。SAMRUM 随后会展示两个人之间形成的模式，例如伴侣、家长与孩子或兄弟姐妹之间的互动。

在 ChatGPT 中，你可以：
- 询问自己的档案内容，或并排比较两位家庭成员（以图表显示）
- 一次查看一项伴侣、亲子、手足或家庭报告中的模式
- 查看本周重点培养计划中的步骤
- 争吵后重新查看最新的 Right now 指南

ChatGPT 只读取你在 SAMRUM 中本来就能看到的内容。它显示昵称和粗略等级（高、中、低），绝不会显示原始答案、精确分数或全名，也无法更改账户中的任何内容。你需要拥有 SAMRUM 账户，且至少完成一项测试。

payload.name: STILL Artwork Credits
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create source-aware artwork credits, figure captions, and citations in Chicago, MLA, and APA. Import supported artwork records from The Met and the Cleveland Museum of Art, or provide metadata manually. STILL preserves museum credit lines, source URLs, licensing information, provenance, warnings, and exact UTC observation times. Available in English and Ukrainian. Generated credits do not grant permission to use an image and are not legal clearance.
payload.longDescription: 生成注明来源的作品说明、图注，以及 Chicago、MLA 和 APA 格式的引文。可导入 The Met 和克利夫兰艺术博物馆支持的作品记录，也可手动提供元数据。STILL 会保留博物馆署名行、来源 URL、许可信息、出处记录、警告，以及精确到 UTC 的观察时间。支持英语和乌克兰语。生成的署名信息并不授予图片使用权限，也不构成法律许可。

payload.name: CLSTR News Tracker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CLSTR gives ChatGPT memory of the news. It reads over 100,000 articles a day from 40,000+ sources, groups every article about the same event into one deduplicated item, and links related events into "situations": ongoing storylines with a maintained summary and a full timeline.

Ask what is happening around a topic, company, country or event and get one synthesized storyline instead of twenty near-duplicate headlines. Ask what has happened with a situation since a given date and get the whole arc, in order, with a count of how many sources reported each development and a link to every one of them.

What it can do:
- Search the news by topic, entity, company or country
- List the situations developing right now, optionally by category, country or time window
- Return the complete timeline of one situation, newest first
- Return the detail of a single event with its source articles
payload.longDescription:
CLSTR为ChatGPT提供新闻记忆功能。它每天从40,000多个信息源中阅读超过100,000篇文章，将关于同一事件的每篇文章归类为一个去重条目，并将相关事件关联为「情境」：包含持续故事线的完整摘要和时间轴。

询问某个主题、公司、国家或事件的最新动态，将获得一个综合故事线，而非二十个近似重复的新闻标题。询问某个情境自特定日期以来的发展情况，将按时间顺序呈现完整发展脉络，包含每个进展的报道来源数量及对应链接。

主要功能：
- 按主题、实体、公司或国家搜索新闻
- 列出当前正在发展的场景（可按类别/国家/时间窗口筛选）
- 按最新优先顺序返回单个场景的完整时间线
- 展示单个事件的详细信息及原始报道链接

payload.name: Dike
payload.description: 搜索并引用中东和北非法律
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Dike connects ChatGPT to primary legal sources from Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, and Egypt, in Arabic and English. Search legislation, court rulings, and fatawa. Get answers that cite the retrieved source text. Resolve a citation, such as a law number and year, to the document it refers to. Check whether a law has been amended or repealed by following its citation graph. Answers are checked against the retrieved sources before they are returned, and claims that cannot be verified are left out. Coverage varies by country. For example, UAE material is currently court decisions and rules from the DIFC and ADGM, and Kuwait is legislation.
payload.longDescription: Dike 将 ChatGPT 连接到沙特阿拉伯、阿联酋、卡塔尔、科威特和埃及的阿拉伯语及英语一手法律来源。搜索法律法规、法院裁决和教法意见（fatwa）。获取引用已检索来源原文的答案。可将法律编号和年份等引文解析为对应文档，并沿引文关系图检查法律是否已修订或废止。答案会在返回前依据检索到的来源进行核查，无法验证的主张将被省略。各国覆盖范围不同。例如，当前阿联酋资料为 DIFC 和 ADGM 的法院判决及规则，科威特资料则为法律法规。

payload.name: MatchLah
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your MatchLah parent or tutor account to arrange Singapore-focused tuition. Parents can prepare and submit private tutor requests and check their status. Tutors can create a profile, update it while pending review, and preview and save an optional profile photo. Review each draft before confirming submission to MatchLah.

Online lessons can connect parents, learners and tutors overseas. In-person lessons take place in Singapore. Rates are in Singapore dollars, with lesson time zones confirmed. Requests and profiles require admin review; submission does not guarantee approval, tutor contact or an assignment.

The connector collects lesson details and optional non-medical educational preferences. Do not provide diagnoses, medical or disability details, government identifiers, payment-card data or authentication secrets. Tutor gender is disclosed for public-profile matching; photos are optional profile images, not identity verification or biometric analysis.

Photo transfer depends on the host, with a private upload link as a fallback. Optional editing depends on the chat application. Approved tutor profiles and changes to submitted parent requests use the website or support.
payload.longDescription:
将你的 MatchLah 家长或导师账户连接起来，安排专注新加坡的辅导。家长可以准备并提交私人导师请求，查看请求状态；导师可以创建个人档案，在审核期间更新档案，并预览和保存可选的个人照片。向 MatchLah 提交前，请先审阅每份草稿。

在线课程可以连接海外家长、学习者和导师。线下课程在新加坡进行。费用以新加坡元计，课程时区会确认。请求和档案均需管理员审核；提交不保证获批、导师联系或成功匹配。

连接器会收集课程详情和可选的非医疗教育偏好。请勿提供诊断、医疗或残障详情、政府身份标识、支付卡数据或身份验证密钥。导师性别会为公开档案匹配而披露；照片是可选的档案图片，不用于身份验证或生物特征分析。

照片传输取决于主机，必要时会使用私密上传链接作为备用。可选编辑取决于聊天应用。已批准的导师档案以及对已提交家长请求的更改，请通过网站或支持渠道进行。

payload.name: CleverPrep Interview Research
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find CleverPrep's published company-and-role interview research and editorial practice questions. Search for a matching guide and retrieve relevant sections to support a preparation plan or public practice discussion in ChatGPT. Optional original-guide links provide source attribution. Practice questions are not confirmed employer questions. This plugin provides two read-only research tools; it has no checkout or payment operation.
payload.longDescription: 查找 CleverPrep 发布的公司和职位面试研究及编辑团队练习题。在 ChatGPT 中搜索匹配指南并获取相关章节，用于准备计划或公开练习讨论。可选的原始指南链接提供来源归属。练习题不代表已确认的雇主面试题。本插件提供两个只读研究工具，不包含结账或付款操作。

payload.name: Egleze
payload.description: 搜索经核实的播客新闻
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Egleze helps users search attribution-verified podcast moments, browse the latest coverage by topic, inspect published episode summaries and key points, and discover covered shows with canonical links back to Egleze.
payload.longDescription: Egleze 帮助用户搜索带有来源核验的播客片段、按主题浏览最新报道、查看已发布的节目摘要和要点，并发现相关节目及其指向 Egleze 的规范链接。

payload.name: ChildEdu Studio
payload.description: 创建可打印的学习材料
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ChildEdu Studio guides teachers, parents, and therapists through creating printable educational materials in multiple languages. Users select the material language, material type, and learning content, then receive a generated file ready to preview and download.
payload.longDescription: ChildEdu Studio 帮助教师、家长和治疗师制作多语言可打印教育材料。用户选择材料语言、材料类型和学习内容，随后即可获得生成的文件，以供预览和下载。

payload.name: FootballGPT
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FootballGPT helps football coaches use their saved coaching setup (age group, format, club type, formation, experience, qualifications, priorities and squad shape) to get coaching advice, build structured training sessions, search a practice library, and create saved animated practices. Player names, ages, shirt numbers and notes never leave FootballGPT through this app. Coaches remain responsible for reviewing and adapting every recommendation for their players.
payload.longDescription: FootballGPT 帮助足球教练使用已保存的执教设置（年龄组、比赛形式、俱乐部类型、阵型、经验、资质、优先事项和球队阵容情况），获取执教建议、制定结构化训练课程、搜索训练活动库并创建已保存的动画训练活动。球员姓名、年龄、球衣号码和备注不会通过此应用离开 FootballGPT。教练仍需负责审核并根据球员情况调整所有建议。

payload.name: Any Topic Academy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create a personalized course on any topic, learn through adaptive lessons, take quizzes and assessments, and track mastered concepts, gaps, and progress. Continue from another chat or device with your personal code.
payload.longDescription: 在任意主题上创建个性化课程，通过自适应课程学习，参加测验和评估，并跟踪已掌握知识点、知识缺口和学习进度。通过个人代码从其他聊天或设备继续学习。

payload.name: Policy Scope
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Japanese policy documents in Policy Scope and review document text, sources, related materials, ministries, councils, and meeting information. All tools are read-only and cannot create, modify, or delete data.
payload.longDescription: 在 Policy Scope 中搜索日本政策文件，并查看文件文本、来源、相关材料、主管部门、委员会和会议资料。所有工具均为只读，无法创建、修改或删除数据。

payload.name: Polyglot Cards
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Load your Polyglot Cards vocabulary, teaching preferences, optional recent lesson recaps, and lesson choices in one preparation step. Practise Recall, Build a Sentence, or Conversation using familiar vocabulary or words selected from actual recent review successes, struggles, or first introductions. Save an agreed mixed batch of words, phrases, and grammar cards with duplicate checks and safe retries. Recaps and closing flag checks remain optional. Manage existing cards and media on request. The app handles long-term spaced repetition. An account is required; voice and tool availability depend on your ChatGPT experience.
payload.longDescription: 通过一个准备步骤，加载 Polyglot Cards 词汇、教学偏好、可选的近期课程回顾以及课程选择。使用熟悉词汇或从近期实际复习中掌握、遇到困难或首次接触的词语进行回忆、造句或对话练习。经双方确认后，保存一批混合的单词、短语和语法卡片，并进行重复项检查和安全重试。课程回顾和结束时的标记检查均为可选。按要求管理现有卡片和媒体。该应用负责长期的间隔重复学习。需要账户；语音和工具的可用性取决于您的 ChatGPT 使用体验。

payload.name: Hill Monitor
payload.description: 搜索议会信息并管理提醒
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hill Monitor answers questions about Canadian Parliament. It searches House and Senate transcripts, Question Period, committee schedules, the Canada Gazette, government news, press conferences, bills, the Order Paper, Orders in Council, MP and senator posts, and ministerial office staff. Signed-in users can list their phrase alerts, see recent hits, and create a new alert.
payload.longDescription: Hill Monitor 可回答有关加拿大议会的问题。它会搜索众议院和参议院记录、质询时间、委员会日程、Canada Gazette、政府新闻、新闻发布会、法案、议事日程、枢密令、议员和参议员帖子，以及部长办公室工作人员信息。登录用户可以查看短语提醒列表、查看近期命中情况并创建新提醒。

payload.name: Oboeru
payload.description: 会话英语转为复习卡片
payload.summaryOriginal: 会話の英語を復習カードに保存
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ChatGPTで練習した英語表現を、日本語と英語のフラッシュカードとして自分のOboeruアカウントに保存します。瞬間英作文の練習手順、接続確認、保存先デッキの一覧表示に対応します。カード登録にはOboeruアカウントへのログインと連携許可が必要です。保存したカードはOboeruのWebアプリで復習できます。既存カード本文や学習履歴の読み取りには対応していません。
payload.longDescription: 将你在 ChatGPT 中练习的英语表达，以日英双语闪卡的形式保存到自己的 Oboeru 账户。支持即时造句练习流程、连接确认和查看保存目标卡组。添加卡片需要登录并授权连接 Oboeru 账户。保存的卡片可在 Oboeru Web 应用中复习。不支持读取现有卡片内容或学习记录。

payload.name: SimpleFeed News Free MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The SimpleFeed News Free MCP brings rights-cleared summary content into OpenAI. Search hundreds of premium publishers by topic, outlet, publisher, metadata date and more. Get article summariesin HTML, markdown and vectors for your testing prior to upgrading the paid version. Sign in with your existing free SimpleFeed account. This listing does not include full article text from SimpleFeed News & Video MCP.
payload.longDescription: SimpleFeed News Free MCP 将已获授权的摘要内容引入 OpenAI。通过主题、来源、出版商、元数据日期等条件搜索数百家优质出版社。提供 HTML、Markdown 和向量格式的文章摘要，供升级付费版本前进行测试。需使用现有免费 SimpleFeed 账户登录。本产品不包含来自 SimpleFeed News & Video MCP 的完整文章内容。

payload.name: FluoTest
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FluoTest helps authenticated users create scored quiz drafts, inspect quiz questions and settings, review aggregate results, update quiz content, publish quizzes, and delete quizzes with an explicit confirmation step.
payload.longDescription: FluoTest帮助已认证用户创建评分测验草稿，检查测验问题和设置，查看汇总结果，更新测验内容，发布测验，并需经过明确确认步骤才能删除测验。

payload.name: Sudoku by Puzzle Fuel
payload.description: 每日数独挑战，边玩边学
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get today's puzzle at any of six difficulties — from Beginner to Diabolical — on a board you can actually play, or generate a fresh puzzle whenever you want one. More importantly, learn how to solve: every hint names the real technique in play and teaches you to spot it yourself, drawn from our Sudoku University teaching program and its twenty-technique glossary.
payload.longDescription: 在可实际游玩的棋盘上，以六种难度（从初级到地狱级）获取今日谜题，或随时生成全新谜题。更重要的是，学习解题技巧：每个提示会明确指出实际使用的技巧，并教你自行识别，这些技巧均来自我们的数独大学教学计划及其二十种技巧的术语表。

payload.name: Carnet de Padres
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Carnet de Padres helps adult parents and caregivers find Spanish-language educational resources for everyday family life. Explore 35 age-based routes from pregnancy to age 18 and 18 Alma activities about emotions and living together. Search by topic and age, read a practical action, an adaptable phrase or an activity, and check the source. Five resources also include attributed complementary readings from external institutions. These selections do not imply institutional review or endorsement. These resources provide educational guidance, not diagnosis, treatment or clinical assessment. Alma adaptations do not claim accredited professional review. The plugin does not manage accounts, purchases or access to private courses or books.
payload.longDescription: Carnet de Padres助力成年家长和照护者获取西班牙语教育资料，支持日常家庭生活。探索35个基于年龄的路径，涵盖从怀孕到18岁的成长阶段，以及18项关于情绪管理和共同生活的Alma活动。通过主题和年龄筛选，阅读实用行动指南、可调整的表达方式或互动活动，并查阅资料来源。其中五项资源还包含来自外部机构的附带补充读物。这些资料选择不代表任何机构的审核或认可。提供的资源仅用于教育指导，不构成诊断、治疗或临床评估。Alma改编内容未声称获得专业认证审查。插件不管理账户、购买行为或私人课程与书籍的访问权限。

payload.name: Nanan Legal Research
payload.description: 验证科特迪瓦法律来源
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Nanan’s curated Côte d’Ivoire and OHADA legal corpus. Retrieve source text and provenance, verify article citations and quoted wording, and inspect exact corpus coverage with canonical links. Results are legal information, not legal advice.
payload.longDescription: 搜索Nanan整理的科特迪瓦及OHADA法律语料库。获取原文本及来源信息，验证条款引用和引用内容，通过规范链接检查语料库具体覆盖范围。结果为法律信息，而非法律建议。

payload.name: PTD Today Cosmos
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PTD Today Cosmos lets you explore questions as connected systems. Ask about a topic and follow related stations, evidence, relationships, and scenario paths to understand how changes can ripple across technologies, markets, organizations, places, and time.
payload.longDescription: PTD Today Cosmos 让您能够将问题视为相互关联的系统来探索。提出某个主题相关的问题，通过相关节点、证据、关系和情景路径，理解变化如何在技术、市场、组织、地点和时间维度产生连锁反应。

payload.name: Mini Course Generator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create and manage courses in your Mini Course Generator account. Draft modules and lessons, publish them for learners, organize course content, and review learner progress and quiz responses. You can also import media and manage course access for learners.
payload.longDescription: 在您的 Mini Course Generator 账户中创建和管理课程。草拟模块和课时，发布给学习者，整理课程内容，并查看学习者进度和测验反馈。您还可以导入媒体并管理学习者的课程访问权限。

payload.name: Nerdy
payload.description: 保存学习内容，稍后复习。
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Nerdy keeps the understanding you want to remember. Plan a learning pathway, learn one concept at a time with your AI tutor, and save the explanation that clicked after you explicitly agree. Return in a new conversation to revise from your saved Kites, record recall evidence, and see when to come back. You can also clarify and approve corrections to a specific Kite or create a compact chapter Review Sheet. Nerdy stores your learning record and source references; it does not receive source files or import full chat history. AI-authored content can be wrong, and grounding labels do not verify accuracy. Requires a Nerdy account.
payload.longDescription:
Nerdy会保存你想要记住的理解内容。
规划学习路径，通过AI导师逐个概念学习，并在你明确同意后保存产生顿悟的解释。
在新对话中返回即可复习已保存的Kites，记录回忆证据，并查看何时回来复习。
你也可以对特定Kites进行澄清和批准修正，或创建简洁的章节复习提纲。
Nerdy会存储你的学习记录和来源引用；它不会接收源文件或导入完整聊天记录。
AI生成的内容可能有误，基础标签无法验证准确性。
需要Nerdy账户。

payload.name: Retri
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Retri turns useful things you learn with an AI assistant into durable spaced-repetition cards and schedules each review when it will help most. Create guided decks, add consistent cards with optional Markdown, review due cards interactively, edit your library, and track your learning progress.
payload.longDescription: Retri将你与AI助手学习到的有用内容转化为持久的间隔重复卡片，并在最有助于巩固的时候安排每次复习。创建引导式卡片组，通过可选的Markdown添加一致性的卡片，以互动方式复习待复习的卡片，编辑你的卡片库，并追踪学习进度。

payload.name: Mataró
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find published news about Mataró, upcoming local events, and recent information on trains, traffic, public notices, weather, and air quality. News and event results link to Mataró.fm, where their sources are listed. Live information includes observation times and may not cover every disruption.
payload.longDescription: 获取关于马塔罗的已发布新闻、本地活动预告，以及火车班次、交通状况、公告信息、天气和空气质量的最新动态。新闻与活动信息结果会链接至Mataró.fm，其来源列表可在该网站查看。实时信息包含观测时间，但可能无法涵盖所有中断情况。

payload.name: Sophie Tutor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sophie Tutor opens an interactive AP Calculus lesson next to the chat. Each lesson moves one step at a time: an animation shows the idea, a short text explains it, and multiple-choice questions check understanding. A wrong answer explains the mistake and lets the student try again; a right answer shows why it is right. At the end, the student sees a short summary and a score.

Lessons cover AP Calculus AB and BC topics: limits and continuity, average and instantaneous rates of change, derivatives from the definition, the product rule, the chain rule, higher derivatives, L’Hôpital’s rule, optimization, u-substitution, definite integrals on a calculator, differential equations from word problems, and area in polar coordinates.

It is for high-school students who take AP Calculus, and for anyone who wants to review a calculus topic visually. Sophie Tutor only opens a lesson when one matches the topic; for other topics, ChatGPT helps as usual. It needs no account and collects no personal information.
payload.longDescription:
Sophie Tutor在聊天界面旁打开交互式AP微积分课程。每节课逐步推进：动画展示概念，简短文字解释原理，选择题检测理解程度。答错时会解释错误原因并允许学生重新尝试；答对时会说明正确理由。课程结束时学生可看到简要总结和得分。

课程涵盖AP微积分AB和BC课程内容：极限与连续性、平均变化率与瞬时变化率、定义法求导数、乘积法则、链式法则、高阶导数、洛必达法则、优化问题、u替换积分法、计算器计算定积分、由实际问题构建微分方程、极坐标下的面积计算等。

适用于学习AP微积分的高中生，以及希望通过视觉化方式复习微积分概念的人群。当话题匹配时Sophie Tutor会打开对应课程；其他话题则继续使用常规的ChatGPT功能。无需账户且不收集任何个人信息。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Interactive AP Calculus lessons, Multiple-choice practice with explanations

payload.name: The Living Bread
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Meet Christ and your family in Christ. The Living Bread is a Christian community. With this plugin, ChatGPT reads Scripture word for word from a stored public domain Bible, never generated; finds the verses the house pairs with what you carry, grief, fear, anxiety, loneliness, gratitude; answers honest questions about Jesus, forgiveness, suffering and how to begin, from Scripture; finds real churches and gatherings near any city, from Seattle to Lagos to Madrid, with service times when known; shows the Tables where real people are talking and praying right now, the prayers believers have left at places near you, the gospel in the house's own words, and the doors of the Christian heritage: denominations, saints, sacred sites, the people and places of the Bible. Signed in, it reads only for you: the prayers real people have prayed over you by name, in their own voices, with the door to hear each one; the prayers you gave and how they are going; what you said yes to; your family circles and next gatherings. This plugin is read only. It never prays in your name, never records or sends anything, and never writes to your account; every act of prayer and reply happens in the app itself, by your own hand. Everything points to Jesus Christ.
payload.longDescription:
在《生命之粮》中遇见基督和你的基督家庭。
《生命之粮》是一个基督教社群。
通过此插件，ChatGPT会逐字阅读存储的公共领域圣经内容，从不生成；根据您所承载的悲伤、恐惧、焦虑、孤独、感恩等情感，找到与之对应的经文；从圣经中回答关于耶稣、宽恕、苦难以及如何开始的诚实问题；查找任何城市的实际教会和聚会信息，从西雅图到拉各斯再到马德里，显示已知的礼拜时间；展示实时有人祷告和交谈的餐桌，信徒在您附近留下的祷告内容，以房屋自身语言表达的福音，以及基督教传统之门：教派、圣人、圣地、圣经中的人物和地点。
已登录状态下，仅为您阅读：他人以自己声音为您姓名祷告的祷告内容，可聆听每一条祷告内容；您提交的祷告及其进展；您所同意的事物；您的家庭圈及下次聚会信息。
此插件为只读模式。
它从不以您的名义祷告，从不记录或发送任何内容，也从不写入您的账户；所有祷告与回应行为均在应用内完成，由您亲自操作。
一切皆指向耶稣基督。

payload.name: SBH News
payload.description: SBH News 最新文章和快讯
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SBH News가 공개 발행한 최신 기사와 속보를 읽고, 키워드로 기사를 검색하거나 기사 상세 내용과 운영 테마를 확인할 수 있습니다. 모든 결과에는 원문 링크가 포함되며 비공개 초안 조회, 콘텐츠 작성·수정·삭제, 발행 또는 메시지 전송은 지원하지 않습니다.
payload.longDescription: 您可以阅读SBH News公开发布的最新文章和快讯，通过关键词搜索文章，或查看文章详细内容及运营主题。所有结果均包含原文链接，但不支持查看非公开草稿、内容创建/编辑/删除、发布或发送消息。

payload.name: CollegeFill
payload.description: 整理大学个人资料数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CollegeFill prepares and validates privacy-scoped Master Profile JSON for manual import into the CollegeFill Chrome extension. It supports only five public sections: Academic, Test Scores, Courses & Grades, Activities & Extracurriculars, and Honors / Awards. It can report supported limits and run data-readiness checks for supported Common App and University of California application pages. The MCP is stateless and requires no CollegeFill account or OAuth connection. It does not access browser storage, log in to or control an application website, navigate, save, or submit an application. Users manually import the returned JSON into CollegeFill and review all data and page-specific checks before filling or saving any page.
payload.longDescription: CollegeFill生成并验证隐私范围的主资料JSON，供手动导入CollegeFill浏览器扩展程序。该工具仅支持五个公开部分：学术背景、考试成绩、课程与成绩、活动与课外经历，以及荣誉/奖项。它可以报告支持的限制并运行针对支持的Common App和加州大学申请页面的数据就绪性检查。MCP为无状态设计，无需CollegeFill账户或OAuth连接。它不会访问浏览器存储、登录或控制应用网站、导航、保存或提交申请。用户需将生成的JSON手动导入CollegeFill，在填写或保存任何页面前审查所有数据和页面特定检查。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: List the five supported profile sections and target limits, Create privacy-scoped CollegeFill Master Profile JSON, Validate CollegeFill Master Profile JSON before import, Check supported profile data for Common App readiness, Check supported profile data for UC readiness

payload.name: English Exercises
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Practise English with existing grammar and vocabulary exercises inside ChatGPT. Find a topic and CEFR level, then complete gap-fill questions, sentence transformations or click-to-edit corrections. Get instant marking, hints, explanations and a final score with mistake review. Results stay in the current player; account progress is not saved. Dictation and audio practice are available on the website rather than through this plugin.
payload.longDescription: 通过ChatGPT内置的语法和词汇练习来练习英语。选择一个主题和CEFR等级，然后完成填空题、句型转换或点击编辑更正。即时评分、提示、解析及最终得分，并附带错误回顾。结果仅保存在当前会话中；账户进度不会保存。听力练习和音频练习仅在网站上提供，而非通过此插件。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find English exercises, Interactive English practice

payload.name: Parrot
payload.description: 在您的水平上练习西班牙语
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring your Parrot Spanish level, streak, and vocabulary into ChatGPT, and save words you learn back to Parrot.

Parrot is a Spanish learning app. Once you connect your Parrot account, ChatGPT can see your Parrot level and the matching CEFR level, your day streak, and the Spanish words you are learning and already know. It uses them to pitch explanations, conversations, and quizzes at your level and around your own words.

When you ask, ChatGPT can save new Spanish words to your Parrot dictionary as learning or known, and count a real practice session toward your Parrot streak.

Who it's for: Parrot learners who want to practice Spanish in ChatGPT with the same level and vocabulary they use in the app.

Limitations: requires a Parrot account. Spanish only. ChatGPT cannot change your Parrot level, and it never sees your email, password, payment details, or listening history. You can disconnect at any time in Parrot under Settings, Connected Apps.
payload.longDescription:
将您的Parrot西班牙语水平、连续天数和词汇带入ChatGPT，并将您学习的单词保存回Parrot。

Parrot是一款西班牙语学习应用。连接您的Parrot账户后，ChatGPT可以查看您的Parrot水平和对应的CEFR级别、连续天数，以及您正在学习和已掌握的西班牙语单词。它会根据您的水平和词汇量提供匹配的解释、对话和测验。

当您请求时，ChatGPT可以将新西班牙语单词保存到您的Parrot词典中，标记为学习中或已掌握，并将一次真实练习计入您的Parrot连续天数。

适用对象：希望在ChatGPT中使用与应用内相同水平和词汇练习西班牙语的Parrot学习者。

限制条件：需要Parrot账户；仅支持西班牙语；ChatGPT无法修改您的Parrot水平，且不会查看您的电子邮件、密码、支付信息或听力记录；您可以在Parrot的设置-连接的应用中随时断开连接。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read Spanish level and streak, List learning and known words, Save words to Parrot, Record daily practice

payload.name: atlas
payload.description: 探索三维人体解剖结构
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore named structures in an interactive 3D anatomy atlas. Search anatomical names and identifiers, choose from detailed male, complete male, standard male, female, embryo and cell models, and open focused views with orbit, zoom, isolation, layers and cross-sections. Students, educators and curious learners can inspect individual organs and compare structures. Model coverage varies, and some reference models are partial. Atlas provides general anatomy education; it does not access patient records, interpret medical scans, diagnose conditions or recommend treatment. No Atlas account is required.
payload.longDescription: 在交互式3D解剖图谱中探索命名结构。搜索解剖学名称和标识符，从详细男性、完整男性、标准男性、女性、胚胎和细胞模型中选择，并开启支持旋转、缩放、隔离、图层和横截面的聚焦视图。学生、教育工作者和好奇的学习者可以检查单个器官并比较结构。模型覆盖范围各不相同，部分参考模型可能不完整。图谱提供基础解剖学教育；不访问患者记录、不解读医学扫描、不诊断病情或推荐治疗方案。无需Atlas账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search anatomy, Explore 3D anatomy, Isolate structures

payload.name: Soreno Mock Interviews
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Practice case and job interviews out loud with a realistic AI interviewer, right in ChatGPT.

Ask for a mock interview and Soreno picks a case for your target role, or search the case bank by firm, industry or topic (market sizing, profitability, M&A and more). Tap Start and talk it through by voice: the interviewer leads like a McKinsey, BCG or Bain interviewer, shares exhibits on screen when it's time and pushes on your math and structure. Behavioral, fit and finance technical rounds work the same way.

When you finish, Soreno scores you against an interviewer rubric and shows strengths, what to improve and concrete next steps, and ChatGPT can coach you on it. Your interviews and feedback stay in your Soreno account at app.soreno.ai.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中通过现实的AI面试官进行大声模拟面试。

请求模拟面试，Soreno会根据你的目标职位选择一个案例，或通过公司、行业或主题（市场测算、盈利能力、并购等）搜索案例库。
点击开始后通过语音进行模拟：面试官将像麦肯锡、BCG或贝恩的面试官一样引导，到相应环节会在屏幕显示图表，并对你的数学计算和逻辑结构进行深入追问。
行为面试、适配度评估和技术类金融环节的模拟方式相同。

完成面试后，Soreno将根据面试官评分标准为你打分，展示优势领域、待改进方向及具体提升步骤，ChatGPT可针对此进行辅导。
你的所有面试记录与反馈将保存在Soreno账户中，访问地址：app.soreno.ai。

payload.name: World War Watcher
payload.description: 引用伊朗-美国战争简报
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
World War Watcher tracks the Iran–US war and its effects on shipping, energy, cloud infrastructure and connectivity. Ask what happened on a given day or over a period, what a source reported and how credible it is, how intense the war is now and how that has changed, where US crude and the Strategic Petroleum Reserve stand, whether Gulf cloud regions and Red Sea and Hormuz cables are affected, or how many interceptors and missiles each side holds.

Every answer comes from World War Watcher's human-curated record: daily dispatches, a dated timeline of over 1,400 events with their sources, a registry of graded sources, and live feeds. Each result carries a link to the page it came from, so claims can be checked.

Limitations: it covers the Iran–US war only; it reads public data and changes nothing; the escalation score measures current intensity and is not a forecast; stockpile counts are curated estimates with a confidence grade and an assessment date; it gives no trading advice and does not predict strikes. Data is licensed CC BY-NC 4.0.
payload.longDescription:
World War Watcher追踪伊朗-美国战争及其对航运、能源、云基础设施和连接性的影响。您可以询问某一天或一段时间内发生了什么，某来源报告的内容及其可信度，当前战争的激烈程度及其变化情况，美国原油和战略石油储备的现状，波斯湾云区域以及红海和霍尔木兹电缆是否受到影响，以及双方各自持有的拦截弹和导弹数量。

所有回答均来自World War Watcher的人工整理记录：每日简报、超过1400个事件的带日期时间线及其来源、分级来源登记册和实时信息流。每个结果都会附带指向原始页面的链接，以便核实相关声明。

限制条件：仅涵盖伊朗-美国战争；仅读取公开数据且不进行任何更改；升级评分用于衡量当前激烈程度，而非预测未来；库存数量为人工整理的估算值，附带可信度评级和评估日期；不提供交易建议，也不预测袭击事件。数据采用CC BY-NC 4.0许可。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search dispatches and region profiles, Read cited passages, Search the dated event timeline, Search the graded source registry, Escalation score and trend, US oil supply and SPR, Gulf cloud, connectivity and cable status, Curated weapon stockpiles, Situation card

payload.name: Confetto Mock Interviews
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Practice your medical school, residency or health-program interview out loud with a realistic AI interviewer, right in ChatGPT.

Ask for a mock interview and Confetto picks a question for your program (MMI ethics, personal, policy, teamwork and more), or choose one from the question bank. Tap Start and answer by voice: the interviewer asks natural follow-ups like a real admissions panel. When you finish, Confetto scores your answer against an admissions rubric and shows what went well, what to improve and a full breakdown, and ChatGPT can coach you on it.

Works for medical school (MD/DO, MMI and traditional), residency (including CaRMS), PA, dental, vet, nursing, pharmacy, PT and OT programs. Your interviews and feedback stay in your Confetto account at app.confetto.ai.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中，通过逼真的AI面试官，出声练习医学专业、住院医师或健康项目面试。

请求模拟面试后，Confetto会为你的项目（MMI伦理问题、个人问题、政策问题、团队合作等）选取题目，或从题库中自主选择。
点击开始后通过语音作答：面试官会像真实招生委员会一样提出自然的后续问题。
完成面试后，Confetto将根据招生评分标准对你的回答进行打分，展示优势所在、需改进之处及详细分析，ChatGPT还可针对内容进行辅导。

适用于医学专业（MD/DO、MMI及传统模式）、住院医师（含CaRMS）、 Physician Assistant（PA）、牙科、兽医、护理、药学、物理治疗（PT）和职业治疗（OT）项目。
您的面试记录和反馈将保存在app.confetto.ai的Confetto账户中。

payload.name: Diffit for Teachers
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn classroom content into ready-to-print materials with editable exports. Diffit helps K-12 teachers create and recreate worksheets, activities, slides, and lessons with classroom-ready formatting, properly formatted math graphics and mathematical notation, and consistent quality grounded in research-backed pedagogy.

Use Diffit when you need a printable student worksheet, readable equations, well-formatted mathematical graphics, or an editable classroom resource. Start from a topic, standard, passage, article, questions, or existing material. Preserve the learning goal and rigor while adapting grade level, reading level, language, or scaffolds to make learning accessible.

Try "this worksheet's formatting is wrong; recreate it as a printable activity," "make this math worksheet with properly formatted fractions and graphics," "turn these questions into an editable student handout," or "create slides for mitosis."

For elementary, middle school, and high school teachers. Available formats and adaptations depend on the connected Diffit tools. Recreating a resource from supplied content does not imply direct editing of every existing file type.
payload.longDescription:
通过可编辑的导出功能将课堂内容转化为可直接打印的材料
Diffit帮助K-12教师创建和重新创建工作表、活动、幻灯片和课程，提供符合课堂标准的格式、正确格式化的数学图形和数学符号，以及基于研究的教育方法支撑的一致性质量。

当需要打印的学生工作表、可读的公式、格式良好的数学图形或可编辑的课堂资源时，请使用Diffit
从主题、标准、文章、段落、问题或现有材料开始
在调整年级水平、阅读难度、语言或辅助工具时，保持学习目标和严谨性，使学习更具可及性。

可以尝试「这份练习的格式有误；重新制作成可打印的活动」、「用正确格式的分数和图形制作这份数学练习」、「将这些问题转化为可编辑的学生手册」或「为有丝分裂制作幻灯片」。

payload.name: MolViewer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: View proteins, DNA, AlphaFold predictions and small molecules in interactive 3D, right in the chat. Ask for a structure by name or ID, rotate and zoom it, switch between cartoon, stick and surface views, and color by chain, secondary structure or AlphaFold confidence. Get structure facts such as experimental method, resolution, chains, ligands and helix and sheet ranges from the Protein Data Bank, AlphaFold DB and PubChem. Open any view on molviewer.bio for measurements, sharing and export. MolViewer only visualizes public structures: it never gives synthesis routes, doses or acquisition advice.
payload.longDescription: 在聊天中直接查看蛋白质、DNA、AlphaFold预测结果和小分子的交互式3D模型。通过名称或ID请求结构，旋转缩放模型，切换卡通图、棍状图和表面图视图，并按链、二级结构或AlphaFold置信度着色。从蛋白质数据银行、AlphaFold数据库和PubChem获取结构事实，例如实验方法、分辨率、链信息、配体以及螺旋和折叠片范围。在molviewer.bio打开任意视图进行测量、分享和导出。MolViewer仅可视化公开结构：它从不提供合成路线、剂量或采购建议。

payload.name: Growby
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Growby brings its pregnancy and early-childhood guides into ChatGPT. Ask what typically happens in any week of pregnancy — with a size card showing how big your baby is now and this week's tips — time contractions, count your baby's kicks, time breastfeeds or do a guided kegel session right in the chat, tick off your hospital bag checklist, check CDC's developmental milestones for your child's age, work out how far along you are (including from an IVF transfer date) from your last period or due date, see what's typical for a child from newborn to five years, or search Growby's library for topics like sleep, feeding and teething. Every answer comes with short articles and the public-health sources they are based on (CDC, NICHD, Office on Women's Health, MedlinePlus), in 30+ languages. Growby is for general information only and is not medical advice — always talk to your doctor, midwife or pediatrician about your own health or your child's.

payload.name: uNotes
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
uNotes is a study library of university course materials — past exams, assignments, lab reports and lecture notes, organized by school and course. The uNotes plugin gives ChatGPT read access to that library and to the user's own study data: it can search the library, open a document and read its full text, list the user's flashcard decks and quizzes, look up their study streak, check how much of their monthly quota is left, and list the schools and courses they follow.

Every tool is read-only. The plugin exposes eight tools, all declared readOnlyHint:true / destructiveHint:false / idempotentHint:true, and none of them create, edit or delete anything in a uNotes account. Typical use is asking a question about material the user already has — "what do my Biology notes say about cell structure", "which courses am I following", "how long is my study streak" — and letting ChatGPT pull the answer out of the underlying documents.

Access is authorized with OAuth 2.1: PKCE (S256) with dynamic client registration, an explicit consent screen, and seven granular read scopes (search, documents, flashcards, quizzes, study, profile, library) plus offline_access. Tools are registered per request against the scopes the token actually carries, so a grant that omits a scope makes the matching tools invisible rather than merely blocked. Requests are rate-limited per user, and tools never accept a user identifier as input — every call is scoped to the authenticated account's own data.
payload.longDescription:
uNotes是大学课程资料的学习资料库，包含过往考试、作业、实验报告和讲义笔记，按学校和课程分类。uNotes插件为ChatGPT提供对资料库和用户个人学习数据的只读访问权限：它可以搜索资料库、打开文档并读取全文、列出用户的闪卡套件和测验、查看学习连续天数、检查当月配额剩余量，并列出用户关注的学校和课程。

所有工具均为只读模式。插件暴露了八个工具，均声明为readOnlyHint:true / destructiveHint:false / idempotentHint:true，且这些工具不会在uNotes账户中创建、编辑或删除任何内容。典型用法是向ChatGPT提出关于用户已有资料的问题——例如「我的生物笔记中关于细胞结构说了什么」、「我正在学习哪些课程」、「我的学习连续天数有多长」——然后由ChatGPT从底层文档中提取答案。

授权通过OAuth 2.1实现：使用PKCE（S256）和动态客户端注册、显式同意界面，以及七个细粒度只读作用域（搜索、文档、闪卡、测验、学习、个人资料、资料库）加上offline_access。每个请求会根据令牌实际携带的作用域注册工具，因此若授权缺少某作用域，对应工具将不可见而非仅被阻止。每个用户的请求受速率限制，且工具从不接受用户标识符作为输入——每次调用均限定于已认证账户的自身数据。

payload.name: Biohacking Kompakt
payload.description: 关于补充剂的研究现状
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Biohacking Kompakt ist eine deutschsprachige Faktencheck-Datenbank zu Supplements, Peptiden, Therapien und Longevity-Themen. Zu jedem Thema gibt es den BK-Score: fünf Achsen, die den Wissensstand beschreiben – wie gut am Menschen untersucht, wie gut die Sicherheitslage untersucht ist, wie lange und breit angewendet, wie plausibel der Mechanismus und wie groß der Hype. Dazu die Richtung, in die die vorhandene Evidenz zeigt, und die passende Folge des Podcasts „Biohacking Kompakt“.

Der Score bewertet den Wissensstand, nicht die Substanz. Die App liest live von biohackingkompakt.de, verkauft nichts und gibt keine medizinische Beratung. Zu verschreibungspflichtigen und nicht zugelassenen Substanzen liefert sie ausschließlich die Einordnung der Studienlage – ohne Dosierung, ohne Anwendung, ohne Bezugsquelle.
payload.longDescription:
Biohacking Kompakt是一个德语事实核查数据库，涵盖补充剂、肽、疗法和抗衰老主题。每个主题均配有BK评分：五个评估维度分别反映研究程度（人体实验验证情况）、安全研究程度、应用时长与广度、作用机制合理性以及市场热度。同时展示现有证据的指向方向，并推荐配套播客节目。

评分仅评估知识体系完备性，不涉及物质本身价值。应用实时从biohackingkompakt.de获取数据，不进行任何销售，不提供医疗建议。对于处方药及未获批准的物质，仅提供研究现状归类，不涉及剂量指导、使用方法或购买渠道。
